pages.text: Abstract Napier and Walker's (1967) locomotor category of vertical clinging and leaping (VC&L) is one of the most familiar in primatology. We attempt to reanalyze field observations of locomotion and habitat use in Tarsius bancanus using loglinear modeling.

Introduction
We are all familiar with Napier and Walker's (1967) locomotor category of vertical clinging and leaping (VC&L). Those primates to which it best applies include some of the most morphologically specialized species.
